items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Would that be the one in the band with Paula Barber and Albert Nicholas? ... [INTERVIEWEE] We have Albert Nicholas.

ctx.x: Would that be the one in the band with Paula Barber and Albert Nicholas? I showed you, yes.
Yes, we had a copy of that picture already. They used to play together too in Chicago. In Chicago too.
